text: Version 0.1.2-rc1 is now available for download, addressing the PHP2Shell issue (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619).
Version 0.1.1-rc2 is now available for download, with improved queues and reporting features.
Call Queues and Call Queue Dashboards are now available in OPBX Cloud and OPBX OSS.
OPBX MCP server is now available, use your favorite AI agent to build and configure your PBX or Contact Center.
